name: Tuna Salad Sandwich Bento Box with Edamame, Tomatoes & Mandarin Orange

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.

Fill a small saucepan with a ½-cup hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, add edamame, cover, and reduce heat to medium-high. Simmer until tender, 6-8 minutes. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and place tomatoes in the first small compartment of the bento box.
Wash, dry, peel, and separate mandarin into segments (if desired). Place in the second small compartment of the bento box.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery. Place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Mince capers. Add both to the bowl along with yogurt, mayo, and spices. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ shallot
½ tbsp capers
2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
¼ tsp dill, dried
¼ tsp garlic powder
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna, add to the bowl, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine the tuna salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (120 g) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Spread tuna salad over one slice of bread. Close with the second slice of bread, then cut in half. Place sandwich in the large compartment of the bento box.
Place cooled edamame in the medium compartment of the bento box. Season with salt if desired.
Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
